description.value: La Trattoria is a long-established Italian restaurant in downtown Maple Ridge, open since 1998 and led by a chef with over two decades of Italian culinary experience. The kitchen follows a "la cucina leggera" philosophy — hearty, full-flavoured dishes made with simply prepared, health-conscious ingredients — and offers gluten-free pasta, appetizers, and entrées. An extensive international wine list, including BC VQA selections, rounds out a sit-down dinner experience.
